description: This file defines a PHP trait 'LDAPCommonParamRuleCollection' used for setting up validation rules for LDAP configuration parameters in an HRM system. It includes methods to generate rule collections for various LDAP configuration sections, focusing on LDAP connection settings, data mapping, and user lookup configurations.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Creates and returns a collection of parameter validation rules for LDAP configuration, including connection and general settings.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollectionForDataMapping
methods.description: Creates and returns a collection of validation rules for LDAP data mapping parameters, like first name, last name, and email.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollectionForUserLookupSettings
methods.description: Creates and returns a collection of validation rules for LDAP user lookup settings, including distinguished name, search scope, and attributes.
